target.desired_quantifiers: fixed delta>0 for all sufficiently large N; candidate eventual delta<2
target.gate: finite Stieltjes/Hankel moment positivity for exact symmetric Dicke/binomial mixture

derived_obstructions.infinite_analytic_mgf: For delta>0, Gamma(a+z)Gamma(a-z)exp[-delta*z^2/N] cannot be an mgf on an open real neighborhood: its continuation at it is unbounded.
derived_obstructions.central_log_convexity: For even N, q_(k-1)q_(k+1)/q_k^2 at k=N/2 is (1+2/N)^2 exp[-2delta/N], requiring delta<=N log(1+2/N); this tends to 2 from below and gives N=2 threshold 2 log 2.
derived_obstructions.scope_limit: Neither obstruction decides positivity of the finite q segment for fixed 0<delta<2.

closest_primary_source.citation: Liggett, Steif, Toth, Annals of Probability 35 (2007), 867-914
useful_theorems: Theorem 1.15: asymptotic finite l-extendibility threshold for a different antiferromagnetic Curie-Weiss family
closest_primary_source.mismatch: Classical CW per-configuration weights are a^k b^(k(N-k)); target q is proportional to k!(N-k)! times a Gaussian tilt. The l-extension coupling b=1+c/l is also not the target's N-dependent delta/N scaling.
closest_primary_source.relevance: Framework and finite-moment method only; no direct target PSD theorem or counterexample.
